integrity: Proof by structural translation and finite-rank game; standalone finite checks are supporting only.
scientific_limitations: Pure equality and at most one free team coordinate; uniform quantifiers only. The completeness/converse direction follows from an earlier general result for FOT-downarrow, and classical monadic MSO collapse is prior. No claim to absolute priority; no independent validation.
title: Unary inquisitive team logic collapses exactly to downward-closed first-order properties
